comment: A running CodeSpace session's transcript survives a host restart: the Connection Owner mirrors each running session's events.jsonl (whole lines, by byte offset, only while a session provably runs) and pushes it into the agent-logger hub under .codespaces/<name>, and agent-logger's session-fetch finds sessions synced from a CodeSpace there. AGENT_CODESPACES_TRANSCRIPT_MIRROR=0 turns the mirror off.
